faq.sousTitre: All the answers to find your way around: catalog, workouts, account and contact.

q1.question: How does the JayPartner's site work?
q1.reponse: The home page shows you a catalog of sessions organized by category, a bit like a streaming catalog. Browse the rows, click a session to see its details, then start the workout when you're ready.

q2.question: Do I need an account to work out?
q2.reponse: You can browse the catalog, the Discover section, and Programs without an account. However, to log your sessions, earn XP, and find your history in the Calendar, you need to sign up ("Sign up" button in the menu) and log in.

q3.question: What is the "Discover" page for?
q3.reponse: It's the library of every available movement. You can search a movement by name, filter by level (beginner, intermediate, advanced), or by targeted muscle to understand an exercise before practicing it.

q4.question: What is the "Programs" page for?
q4.reponse: It groups sessions by universe (Strength, Pilates, Hyrox, Athletics...). Choose the tab for the universe that interests you to see all its sessions.

q5.question: How does a workout work?
q5.reponse: From a session's detail page, click "Start the workout". The site switches to full-screen mode, without the menu, so you can focus on the movements. Once the session is complete, it's saved to your history and you earn XP.

q6.question: Where can I see the sessions I've already done?
q6.reponse: In "Calendar" (visible once logged in). It shows a monthly calendar: days marked with a dot correspond to logged sessions. Click a day to see the recap and the XP earned.

q7.question: How do I contact Jay or follow updates on social media?
q7.reponse: Head to the Contact page, or use the floating button at the bottom right of the screen: you'll find WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Calendly to book a coaching session.

q8.question: I forgot my password, or I'm having a technical issue: what should I do?
q8.reponse: The easiest way is to contact me directly via WhatsApp or Instagram from the Contact page: I'll get back to you as quickly as possible to sort it out.

about.sousTitre: I'm Jay, the creator of JayPartner's. Pilates & Fitness coach in Niort.
about.imageAlt1: Jay, Pilates & Fitness coach in Niort
about.p1: Passionate about dance, sport, and wellbeing since I was young, I decided to turn that passion into a mission and became a certified sports coach in 2023.
about.p2: I'm a coach who loves good food: I love effort and movement… but also small pleasures! For me, sport and indulgence can perfectly coexist when you find the right balance. Taking care of yourself also means treating yourself without guilt.
about.p3: I chose this profession to help my JayPeaks reach their goals and, above all, their peak. Together, we'll progress, push our limits, and climb every step to your peak.
about.p4: For me, sport — whether individual or team-based — is always better with a partner. A partner to motivate, support, challenge, and celebrate progress.
about.p5: Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete, I'm your ideal partner to help you recover, develop, and strengthen your physical abilities. So, JayPeak, ready to reach your full potential with me? ⏱️🔥
about.p6: Jay is a Pilates and Fitness coach based in Niort, driven by a genuine passion for movement, wellbeing, and personal transformation.
about.p7: Whether you're a beginner or an experienced athlete, I'll guide you through sessions that are tailored, dynamic, and supportive. My goal: to help you regain strength, mobility, and confidence through Pilates.
